news.title: Healthcare struggles to scale AI past pilot stage: Google report
news.summary: Healthcare bet big on AI pilots. Now, unpredictable costs and mounting technical complexity are threatening to prevent organizations from scaling the tech, according to Google Cloud’s Aashima Gupta.
news.title_zh: 醫療業難以將 AI 擴展至試點階段之後：Google 報告
news.summary_zh: 醫療業在 AI 試點上投入巨資。如今，不可預測的成本和日益增加的技術複雜性正威脅著阻止組織擴展該技術，據 Google Cloud 的 Aashima Gupta 指出。

news.title: Musk: Nvidia’s Key Supply Deals Were “a Handshake With Jensen.” Now Google Is Begging for Capacity
news.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk says many of NVIDIA’s supply deals rested on a handshake with Jensen Huang, and that some will be lost now that Huang has resigned as CEO. Dylan Patel says Google is already asking NVIDIA’s small suppliers for capacity, and Alphabet has the cash to back that up, with its TPU chips built by Broadcom.
news.title_zh: 馬斯克：輝達關鍵供應協議僅是「與黃仁勳握手」。如今谷歌正乞求產能
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：馬斯克表示，輝達許多供應協議建立在與黃仁勳的握手基礎上，現在黃仁勳已辭去CEO職位，部分協議將告吹。Dylan Patel 指出，谷歌已向輝達的小型供應商尋求產能，Alphabet 有現金支持，其 TPU 晶片由博通製造。

news.title: Reddit Is Down 60% This Year. Time to Buy?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysReddit stock is down 57% this year as Google’s AI search sends it fewer visitors. Reddit still guided to about 40% fourth-quarter growth, and free cash flow hit $1.
news.title_zh: Reddit 今年下跌 60%。現在買入時機到了？
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：Reddit 股價今年下跌 57%，因谷歌 AI 搜尋導致訪客減少。Reddit 仍預期約 40% 第四季成長，自由現金流達到 $1。

news.title: Is Alphabet Stock Cheap Right Now?
news.summary: The stock looks too good to be true at current valuations.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 股票現在便宜嗎？
news.summary_zh: 該股票在當前估值下看起來好得不真實。

news.title: Anthropic’s Lock-Ups Free “Nearly 40% of the Deal” on Day One. That’s a Big Risk for Alphabet and Amazon
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAnthropic’s lock-ups let insiders sell up to 316 million shares on its first trading day, nearly 40% of the 825 million share offering, and about 1. 6 billion within 76 days.
news.title_zh: Anthropic 的鎖定期釋出「近乎 40% 交易額」首日。這對 Alphabet 和 Amazon 是大風險
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：Anthropic 的鎖定期允許內部人士首個交易日出售多達 316 million 股，佔 825 million 股發行量近乎 40%，約 1。6 billion 於 76 天內。

news.title: “Big Short” Investor: Big Tech Could Return to “Positive Cash Flow” in 2027. Meta Gains Most
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSteve Eisman says AI capex could peak in 2027, and the hyperscalers could return to positive cash flow as soon as the second half of that year, if data center construction slows. Charlie Bilello says Meta spends 43% of its revenue on capex, compared with 39% for Microsoft, 34% for Alphabet and 27% for Amazon, so a slowdown would free up the largest share of revenue at Meta.
news.title_zh: 「大空頭」投資人：大型科技股可能在 2027 回歸「正現金流」。Meta 獲益最大
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：Steve Eisman 指出 AI 資本支出可能在 2027 見頂，若資料中心建設放緩，超大規模廠商最快可在該年下半年回歸正現金流。Charlie Bilello 指出 Meta 將 43% 營收用於資本支出，微軟為 39%，Alphabet 為 34%，Amazon 為 27%，因此放緩將釋出 Meta 最大比例營收。

news.title: More Pain For NVDA? Top Supply Chain Analyst Says New OpenAI, Anthropic Chip Orders Boost Google’s TPU Outlook
news.summary: The orders extend Google TPU shipment visibility to 2029, while Nvidia GPUs and other AI accelerators mostly have visibility through 2027 or 2028, according to Ming-Chi Kuo.
news.title_zh: NVDA 更多痛苦？頂級供應鏈分析師稱 OpenAI、Anthropic 新晶片訂單提振 Google TPU 前景
news.summary_zh: 根據郭明錤表示，訂單將 Google TPU 出貨可見度延伸至 2029，而輝達 GPU 和其他 AI 加速器大多僅有可見度至 2027 或 2028。

news.title: Robotaxis Need “20M AVs” for 3-4% of Global Rides, Says Jason Calacanis. Good News for Uber
news.summary: Key TakeawaysJason Calacanis says robotaxis would need 20 million vehicles doing 20-plus rides a day to reach 3% to 4% of global rides, as a Reuters columnist floats the idea of Alphabet buying Uber to strengthen Waymo. That math gives Uber years of ride volume, so its global network is worth more to Alphabet or Tesla as a purchase than as something to beat.
news.title_zh: Robotaxis 需要「20M AVs」才能達到 3-4% 的全球叫車量，Jason Calacanis 指出。這對 Uber 是好消息
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Jason Calacanis 指出，robotaxis 需要 20 million 輛車輛，每天完成 20 趟以上的叫車，才能達到 3% to 4% 的全球叫車量，路透專欄作家提出 Alphabet 收購 Uber 以增強 Waymo 的想法。這筆帳讓 Uber 擁有多年的叫車量，因此其全球網絡對 Alphabet 或 Tesla 來說，作為收購目標比作為競爭對手更有價值。

news.title: Google’s New Gemini Costs Just “$0.82 a Task.” Anthropic’s Best Runs $4.64, Days Before Its IPO
news.summary: Key TakeawaysZapier CEO Wade Foster found that Google’s new Gemini 4 Hydrogen scored 51. 1% on 657 business workflows at about $0.
news.title_zh: Google 新款 Gemini 每項任務成本僅「$0.82」。Anthropic 最佳模型成本 $4.64，距離其 IPO 尚有數天
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Zapier CEO Wade Foster 發現，Google 新款 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 獲得 51 分。在 657 業務工作流程上表現 1%，成本約 $0。

news.title_zh: 一家 $5.9 Billion 基金買入了這些 3 股票

news.title: He Thinks His $200,000 S&P 500 401(k) Spreads His AI Risk. Two Alphabet Share Classes Put $10,380 in One Company. A 20% Drop Could Cost Him $2,076
news.summary: He bought an S&P 500 index fund to avoid betting on any single AI winner. One quirk in how the fund lists its holdings means he may be carrying far more risk in one company than he realizes.
news.title_zh: 他以為他的 $200,000 S&P 500 401(k) 能分散 AI 風險。兩類 Alphabet 股份讓 $10,380 集中在一家公司。20% 下跌可能讓他損失 $2,076
news.summary_zh: 他買入了 S&P 500 指數基金，以避免押注單一 AI 贏家。基金列示持倉的方式有一個特殊之處，意味著他可能在不知情的情況下，在單一公司上承擔了更多風險。

news.summary: Wall Street expects the hyperscalers to keep up their heavy capital expenditures, but it's worried that the revenue growth they are expecting to result from that spending might not show up.
news.title_zh: 億萬富翁比爾·阿克曼表示，華爾街對亞馬遜、微軟、Meta 和 Alphabet 的預期存在巨大脫節
news.summary_zh: 華爾街預期超大規模雲端服務商將維持龐大的資本支出，但擔心預期由此支出產生的營收增長可能不會出現。

items.title: Microsoft Data Shows Claude Is Stalling Against Copilot in Office
items.summary: Anthropic’s latest push into enterprise apps rattled Microsoft investors last week. Microsoft’s own internal data paints a less threatening picture, at least so far. Usage of Anthropic features that allow people to do work inside Microsoft’s Office apps with Claude , such as sorting email or generating slide decks, has been falling further behind usage of Microsoft’s Copilot in recent months, according to internal Microsoft data described by an employee with knowledge of it. The number of weekly users of those features, known as Claude for Microsoft 365, is less than one-tenth the number of weekly users of the paid version of Copilot, Microsoft’s own AI tools, in Office, which has been growing at a much faster rate, the person said.

news.summary: Key TakeawaysJason Calacanis says robotaxis would need 20 million vehicles doing 20-plus rides a day to reach 3% to 4% of global rides, as a Reuters columnist floats the idea of Alphabet buying Uber to strengthen Waymo. That math gives Uber years of ride volume, so its global network is worth more to Alphabet or Tesla as a purchase than as something to beat.

news.title: Nvidia Fallout Adds New Tension to US-China AI Race
news.summary: The US-China technology rivalry is in focus as President Trump travels to China for talks with Xi Jinping, with AI chips, export controls and rare earths among the key issues shaping the relationship. news.title: “Big Short” Investor: Big Tech Could Return to “Positive Cash Flow” in 2027. Meta Gains Most
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSteve Eisman says AI capex could peak in 2027, and the hyperscalers could return to positive cash flow as soon as the second half of that year, if data center construction slows. news.summary: Anthropic said on Tuesday that it has launched its roadshow, a 7 to 10 day period ahead of an IPO in which a company pitches prospective institutional investors like mutual funds, pension funds and hedge funds. Interestingly, the tentative valuation the Claude-maker set, of between $1.26 trillion to $1.4 trillion, was slightly lower than what investors initially expected. (And, it’s also around the $1.25 trillion valuation that OpenAI recently raised $11 billion at, despite the fact that Anthropic generates more revenue. Meanwhile, the largest pure-play robotics company in the world by revenue and market cap is Intuitive Surgical , which makes the da Vinci Surgical System , a multi-armed contraption that human surgeons use on a remote-control basis to perform a variety of operations. news.title_zh: Credo Technology 股價較六月高點下跌 57%：死錢，還是反彈在即？

news.title: AMD Sinks 9%, Marvell Down 5% as Chip Rally Reverses and Treasury Yields Hit 5%
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD fell 9% today, giving back part of this week’s roughly 30% gain after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned. That gain came from Nvidia’s turmoil, and fast money leaves fast.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 AMD 今日下跌 9%，吐回本週約 30% 漲幅的一部分，此前 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 辭職。該漲幅源於 Nvidia 的動盪，熱錢來得快去得也快。

news.title: Marvell Stock Could Have a Bigger AI Opportunity Than Investors Realize
news.summary: Marvell's shares have lost nearly 40% in a month, yet its business is accelerating and a quiet Google deal could rewrite the numbers. So why is the market running the other way, and who is about to be proven wrong?

news.summary_zh: Marvell 股價在一個月內下跌近 40%，但其業務正在加速，且一項低調的 Google 交易可能重寫數字。那麼為何市場卻朝相反方向運作，誰即將被證明錯誤？

news.title: Lumentum Is Up 56% in 2026, but Marvell Now Sets Its Price. Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum stock is up 56% in 2026, well ahead of rival Coherent, but it’s nearly half off its October high after Marvell’s all-stock deal and an AI chip selloff. Lumentum’s business drove the run: September-quarter revenue rose 136.
news.title_zh: Lumentum 在 2026 上漲 56%，但 Marvell 現在決定其價格。獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Lumentum 股價在 2026 上漲 56%，遠超競爭對手 Coherent，但在 Marvell 的全股票交易和 AI 晶片拋售潮後，股價較十月高點已近乎腰斬。Lumentum 的業務推動了漲勢：九月季營收上升 136。

news.title: Marvell Soars 23%, Lumentum Up 23% in a Week. Jim Cramer Says It’s Not “a Broken Stock”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell Technology stock soared 23% in a week, and Lumentum, which Marvell agreed to buy, rose almost as much. CoreWeave’s beat-and-raise revived the AI trade, though Lumentum still trades below the deal’s value.
news.title_zh: Marvell 飆升 23%，Lumentum 一週上漲 23%。Jim Cramer 表示這不是「一檔破股」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Marvell Technology 股價一週飆升 23%，而 Marvell 同意收購的 Lumentum 漲幅幾乎持平。CoreWeave 的超預期表現與上調展望重燃 AI 題材，儘管 Lumentum 仍低於交易估值交易。

news.title: Lumentum Trades Below Marvell’s Buyout Offer. Is the Gap a Bargain?
news.summary: Lumentum's revenue is more than doubling, yet its stock now moves with Marvell's shares and a regulatory clock that runs into 2028. Who actually profits from the discount, and what could erase it?
news.title_zh: Lumentum 股價低於 Marvell 收購要價。這個缺口是便宜貨嗎？
news.summary_zh: Lumentum 營收翻倍以上，但其股價現在隨 Marvell 股價和監管時限移動，時限延至 2028。誰真正從折價中獲利？什麼可能抹平這個折價？

news.title: Advanced Micro Devices vs. Marvell Technology: Which Artificial Intelligence Stock Is a Better Buy Going into 2027?
news.summary: Marvell's forward P/E sits well below AMD's, but its revenue jump and rising margins raise a tougher question about which chip stock can hold up through 2027.
news.title_zh: Advanced Micro Devices 對比 Marvell Technology：進入 2027 哪檔人工智慧股票是更好的買入？
news.summary_zh: Marvell 的遠期市盈率遠低於 AMD，但其營收躍升和利潤率上升提出了更棘手的問題：哪檔晶片股能在 2027 期間撐住。

news.title: Marvell Acquires Lumentum in Blockbuster $80 Billion Deal
news.summary: There has been no shortage of news these last few weeks coming out of the memory and optics sectors in regards to AI investing. Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith are here to break down just a few of them, including Marvell's purchase of Lumentum in a huge $80 billion deal. Marvell has enjoyed a nice surge since the acquisition - one of the largest in tech history - and the company has a history of needing to reshape its brand and business which could be helpful. The two also shared some updates in regards to companies including Micron, Semtech and Alphabet, as well as what investors can expect from them as we move into 2027.
news.title_zh: Marvell 以超級 $80 Billion 交易收購 Lumentum
news.summary_zh: 過去幾週來自記憶體和光學產業關於 AI 投資的消息不絕於耳。Eric Bleeker 和 Austin Smith 在這裡為您分析其中幾項，包括 Marvell 以巨額 $80 billion 交易收購 Lumentum。自收購以來，Marvell 享受了不錯的漲勢——這是科技史上最大筆交易之一——且該公司有重塑品牌和業務的歷史，這可能會有所幫助。兩人還分享了關於 Micron、Semtech 和 Alphabet 等公司的最新動態，以及隨著我們進入 2027，投資人可以從他們身上期待什麼。
